```html
<div class="bg-white shadow-md rounded-lg overflow-hidden">
    <div class="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-200">
        <h3 class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-800">Bookmarks Table</h3>
    </div>
    <div class="p-6 space-y-4">
        @foreach ($bookmarks as $bookmark)
            <div class="border-b border-gray-200 py-4">
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-800">
                        {{ $bookmark->title }}
                    </div>
                    <div class="ml-auto flex space-x-2">
                        @livewire('bookmark-actions', ['bookmark' => $bookmark])
                        <button wire:click="$emit('deleteBookmark', {{ $bookmark->id }})" class="text-sm text-red-500 hover:text-red-700">Delete</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        @endforeach
    </div>
</div>
```
